text_orig: In the latter Teshrî (November) we saw three signs in the sky at midday. One of them was in the midst of the heavens in the south. It resembled in its colour the bow that is in the clouds, and with its concave surface it looked upwards; that is to say, its convex surface was downwards and its extremities were upwards. And there was one on the east, and another also on the west. Again, in the latter Kânûn (January), we saw another sign in the exact southwest corner (γωνία) (of the heavens), which resembled a spear. Some people said of it that it was the besom of destruction, and others said that it was the spear of war.

text.zh-Hans: 在特什里下月（十一月），我们于正午在天空中看见三个征象。其中一个在南方天空正中，颜色像云中的弓，凹面向上，也就是说，凸面向下，两端朝上。东方有一个，西方也另有一个。又在卡努恩下月（一月），我们在（天空的）正西南角看见另一个征象，形如矛。有人说那是毁灭的扫帚，也有人说那是战争之矛。
text.zh-Hant: 在特什裏下月（十一月），我們於正午在天空中看見三個徵象。其中一個在南方天空正中，顏色像雲中的弓，凹面向上，也就是説，凸面向下，兩端朝上。東方有一個，西方也另有一個。又在卡努恩下月（一月），我們在（天空的）正西南角看見另一個徵象，形如矛。有人説那是毀滅的掃帚，也有人説那是戰爭之矛。
text.en: In the latter Teshrî (November) we saw three signs in the sky at midday. One of them was in the midst of the heavens in the south. It resembled in its colour the bow that is in the clouds, and with its concave surface it looked upwards; that is to say, its convex surface was downwards and its extremities were upwards. And there was one on the east, and another also on the west. Again, in the latter Kânûn (January), we saw another sign in the exact southwest corner (γωνία) (of the heavens), which resembled a spear. Some people said of it that it was the besom of destruction, and others said that it was the spear of war.
text.fr: En Tichri II (novembre), nous vîmes trois signes dans le ciel en plein midi. L'un d'eux se trouvait au milieu du ciel, au sud. Il ressemblait par sa couleur à l'arc qui est dans les nuages, et par sa surface concave il regardait vers le haut ; c'est-à-dire que sa surface convexe était vers le bas et ses extrémités vers le haut. Et il y en avait un à l'est, et un autre aussi à l'ouest. Encore, en Kanoun II (janvier), nous vîmes un autre signe dans l'angle exact du sud-ouest (γωνία) (du ciel), qui ressemblait à une lance. Certains disaient de lui que c'était le balai de la destruction, et d'autres disaient que c'était la lance de la guerre.
text.es: En Tishrí II (noviembre), vimos tres signos en el cielo a mediodía. Uno de ellos estaba en medio del cielo, al sur. Se parecía en su color al arco que está en las nubes, y con su superficie cóncava miraba hacia arriba; es decir, su superficie convexa estaba hacia abajo y sus extremos hacia arriba. Y había uno al este, y otro también al oeste. Además, en Kanun II (enero), vimos otro signo en el ángulo exacto del suroeste (γωνία) (del cielo), que se parecía a una lanza. Algunos decían de él que era la escoba de la destrucción, y otros decían que era la lanza de la guerra.
text.it: In Tishri II (novembre), vedemmo tre segni nel cielo a mezzogiorno. Uno di essi era in mezzo al cielo, a sud. Somigliava nel colore all'arco che sta tra le nuvole, e con la sua superficie concava guardava verso l'alto; cioè la sua superficie convessa era in basso e le sue estremità in alto. E ce n'era uno a oriente, e un altro anche a occidente. Ancora, in Kanun II (gennaio), vedemmo un altro segno nell'angolo esatto di sud-ovest (γωνία) (del cielo), che somigliava a una lancia. Alcuni dicevano di esso che era la scopa della distruzione, e altri dicevano che era la lancia della guerra.
text.ja: テシュリー第二月（11月）に、私たちは真昼に天に三つのしるしを見た。そのうちの一つは天の中央の南にあった。それは色が雲の中にある弓に似ており、凹んだ面を上に向けていた。すなわち、凸の面は下にあり、両端は上にあった。また東に一つ、西にもう一つあった。また、カーヌーン第二月（1月）に、私たちは（天の）ちょうど南西の隅（γωνία）に、槍に似た別のしるしを見た。それについて、破壊の箒だと言う者もあれば、戦争の槍だと言う者もいた。
